newsitem.title: DENMARK: FORECAST - GN Store Nord 96 result 5 pct up.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - GN Store Nord 96 result 5 pct up.

text.p: Seven analysts polled by Reuters in a forecast issued on Friday saw 1996 pre-tax results for Danish cable and telecoms group GN Store Nord on average five percent up on 1995.
GN Store Nord's 53.5 percent-owned Sonofon subsidiary competes with monopoly telecoms operator Tele Danmark in the mobile telephone market in Denmark.
The Sonofon unit is not expected though to make a profit until 1997, the company said.
Otherwise the group's main activity comes from cable-laying, with major involvement in a Baltic and other undersea telecommunications cable systems.
The panel foresaw average GN Store Nord 1996 pre-tax profits of 215 million crowns, up from 1995's 204 million crowns on 25.7 percent higher turnover of 2.683 billion crowns.
The pre-tax result estimates ranged from 176-253 million crowns, with turnover forecasts between 2.560-2.850 billion crowns.
Last August GN Store posted first-half 1996 121 million crowns pre-tax profits and said it expected somewhat better whole year results than in 1995.
GN Store Nord issues its 1996 results on Tuesday March 18. --Chris Follett, Copenhagen newsroom +45-33969652
